title: 第四章 锁定
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

凌晨五点半，林越已经站在了北郊冷链物流园的大门前。

天还没亮透。东边的天际线刚泛起一层极淡的鱼肚白，大部分天空还是深铁灰色，几颗残星挂在高处，冷得像是刚从冰水里捞出来的钉子。工业区的早晨比城区安静得多，没有车流声，没有人群，只有远处某台变压器发出的低沉嗡鸣和偶尔从更远的国道上掠过的货车声。

林越比约定时间早到了半小时。这是他前世养成的习惯——任何一个新地点，必须在所有人到达之前先独自侦察一遍。他不信任任何二手情报。

物流园的大门是一道锈迹斑斑的电动伸缩门，门轨里塞满了枯叶和塑料袋。门卫室玻璃碎了半扇，里面空空荡荡，墙上挂着的值班表日期停在五年前的某一天。林越从伸缩门与围墙之间的缝隙侧身挤进去，靴底踩在碎玻璃上发出细碎的咔嚓声。

园区比他想象的更大。卫星图上看是一个规整的长方形，实地站进来才发现纵深至少有三百米。三栋冷库厂房呈品字形分布，主体结构是钢筋混凝土预制板，外挂灰色波纹钢板。林越走近最近的一栋，用手敲了敲墙体——实心的。五十公分厚，跟小何昨晚在卫星图上估算的基本一致。这种厚度的混凝土墙，普通丧尸别说撞开，连裂缝都撞不出来。就是舔食者的骨舌也穿不透。除非是巨力丧尸。但巨力丧尸的数量极少，而且——

他用手指抹了一下墙面的灰。成色不错。五年没人维护，没有明显开裂，没有水渍侵蚀的痕迹。这栋建筑的质量比前世他待过的任何一个基地都好。

园区东北角是水井的位置。林越走过去，发现是一口机井，井口盖着厚重的铸铁井盖，旁边是一间配电房和一座锈蚀的水塔。他掀开井盖，拿手机手电筒往下照——水面在大概八米深处，看不清水质，但至少没有干涸。有水，就是活的。

配电房的门锁已经锈死，林越一脚踹开。里面是一套老旧的柴油发电机组和配电柜，落满了灰，但看上去没有破损。王浩还没到位，但林越前世见过足够多的发电机组，这套设备只要能转，胖子就能让它重新活过来。

他站在园区中央，原地转了一圈，在脑子里完成整体布局的初稿。

正门那栋冷库做主防御工事，一楼改指挥中心和物资仓库，二楼设观察哨。后面两栋——一栋改居住区，另一栋改医疗区和实验室。水塔旁边那块空地，赵德柱的农田。东侧围墙沿线的空地，陆寒霜的训练场。东南角和西北角各设一座哨塔。正门外五十米，第一道铁丝网防线。铁丝网与围墙之间，陷坑和绊索。

他在五分钟之内把整个园区的防御体系从头到尾推演了一遍，然后拿出手机，

“9月13日，05点42分，冷链物流园实地勘察确认。三栋冷库，混凝土预制板结构，墙体厚度约50公分，结构完好。机井一口，水深约八米。配电房含老旧柴油发电机组一台，状态待评估。围墙为砖混结构，高度约2.5米，顶端无铁丝网，需加装。正门电动伸缩门无法使用，需手动封闭。园区面积约1.5万平方米，可容纳一百人以上长期驻扎。基地位置评分：S级。”

他收起手机，走向大门口。赵铭他们的车应该快到了。

六点整，两辆黑色面包车准时出现在物流园门口。车门拉开，五个人鱼贯而出。赵铭下车第一件事不是打招呼，是扫了一眼周围环境——林越注意到他的视线在第一栋冷库的墙体上停了一秒，然后微微点头。老郑更直接，绕到侧面去看围墙高度和背面的地形，一句话没说就走了。

“就是这儿？”大刘抬头看着冷库建筑，下巴微微抬起来，“看着够结实的。”

“五十公分混凝土墙。”林越说，“你拿大锤砸一天也砸不穿。”

小何没说话，已经开始绕园区走了，手里端着一个小型无人机遥控器。阿青跟在后面，背着急救包，左右张望，表情像是第一次进鬼屋。

“林哥。”赵铭走到林越身边，压低声音，“这地方产权怎么搞？虽然是废弃的，总归有个主。”

“查过了。”林越说，“产权归属一家破产清算的冷链公司，资产包已经冻结五年了，没人接。理论上归城北工业园管委会代管。但实际上五年没人管，说明他们也不在乎。”

“那我们直接占？”

“走正规流程。”林越看了他一眼，“租。不是买，不是占。签正式合同。一旦有合同在手，这个地方在法律上就是我们的合法使用空间。末世之后法律可能没用了，但在末世之前，我需要这张纸。有了它，我们去买铁丝网、水泥、发电机配件，不会被当成可疑分子。有了它，我们把人带进来，不会被告非法占用。有了它，就算政府临时征用也得跟我们谈补偿。”

赵铭愣了一下，然后缓慢地点了点头。他显然没想到这一层。前世的赵铭是一个冲锋型的战士，不是谋略型的指挥官。但这一世，林越需要他成长得更快。

“今天是周六。”林越看了一眼手表，“工业园管委会今天不上班。但周一上午，我要在办公室门口等他们开门。在那之前——”

老郑回来了。他的表情比刚才更沉。

“背面有一条小河，河岸宽大概十五米，水深看不出来。河水是往东南方向流的，下游可能通城里的主河道。这是好事，也是坏事。”

“好事是有备用水源，”林越说，“坏事呢？”

“坏事是河岸太低，对岸是一片废弃的建材堆场，视野开阔，没有掩护。如果有人或者丧尸从那个方向过来，我们能看到他们，他们也看得到我们。围墙在后门那个位置有个缺口，大概一米宽，得补。”

林越点头，在心里把后墙缺口的优先级排到了前列。

“小何，”他提高了声音，“航拍跑完了没有？”

小何从不远处跑过来，手里的遥控器屏幕显示着一架小型四轴无人机正在半空中盘旋。他把屏幕转向林越，上面是物流园的俯瞰画面，清晰度很高。

“园区长三百二十米，宽两百一十米。三栋主建筑，一栋配电房，一座水塔，一座废弃的装卸平台。围墙沿整个地块一圈，总长度大概一千零六十米。周边五百米范围内——东边是另一片废弃工业区，两栋空厂房，没有居民。西边隔一条马路是几间修车铺，再往外就是国道。南边是农田，有一排平房，目测是以前的农户，现在还有人住。”

“农户？”林越皱眉。

“一户人。院子里晒着衣服，应该是昨天晒的。”

林越在脑子里记下这个信息。附近的居民是变量，末世爆发后可能变成幸存者，也可能变成威胁。但至少在爆发之前，不能引起任何不必要的注意。

“今天上午的任务——拿下合同。”林越把所有人聚拢过来，“管委会周末不上班，我们就去找能拍板的人。这种事没必要等到周一。小何，我要你今天上午查出一个人的联系方式——工业园管委会负责资产管理的负责人，名字、电话、住址，越快越好。”

小何点头，已经开始在手机上敲字了。

“其他人，留在物流园。大刘和老郑把三栋冷库的内部结构摸清楚。每一层有几个房间、几道门、窗户尺寸、楼梯位置、通风管道走向。画成草图，我回来要看。”

大刘和老郑同时点头。

“赵铭，你带阿青去检查水井。打一桶水上来，看水质干不干净，能不能直接喝。然后检查配电房，把发电机型号拍下来发给我。”

“明白。”赵铭说。

林越转身准备走，又停下脚步，回头看着他们五个人。

“从现在开始，这个物流园就是我们的行动基地。在外面不要说任何关于基地的细节。不管谁问，就说我们租了个仓库，准备做点小生意。存在。”

五个人安静地看着他。没有人说话，但每一个人的眼神都不一样了。昨天在休息室里，他们听到“末世”两个字的时候，眼底还有困惑、怀疑，以及强行压制的不信。但现在——站在这个实实在在的冷链物流园里，摸到厚实的混凝土墙，看到深不见底的机井，那些怀疑正在被一点一点地磨掉。因为林越不是在说，是在做。每一步都是实的。每一个决定都有明确的理由和指向。

林越坐进车里，发动引擎。下一站是苏沐晴。

06点45分，他到达苏沐晴公寓楼下。比约定的九点早了两个多小时。

Page (1/3)

At 5:30 in the morning, Lin Yue was already standing in front of the gate of the northern suburbs cold chain logistics park.

It's not bright yet.A very light fish belly white has just appeared on the eastern skyline, and most of the sky is still dark iron gray. A few remaining stars hang high, as cold as nails just fished out of icy water.Mornings in the industrial area are much quieter than in the city. There is no sound of traffic or crowds, only the low hum of a transformer in the distance and the occasional sound of trucks passing by on the national highway further away.

Lin Yue arrived half an hour earlier than the agreed time.This is a habit he developed in his previous life - any new location must be scouted alone before everyone arrives.He distrusted any second-hand information.

The gate of the logistics park is a rusty electric retractable door, and the door track is filled with dead leaves and plastic bags.Half of the glass in the guard room was broken, and it was empty. The date on the duty list hanging on the wall stopped at a certain day five years ago.Lin Yue squeezed in sideways through the gap between the retractable door and the wall, the soles of his boots making a tiny clicking sound on the broken glass.

The campus is bigger than he imagined.It looked like a regular rectangle on the satellite image, but when we came to the site, we found that it was at least three hundred meters deep.The three cold storage buildings are distributed in a Z-shaped layout. The main structure is reinforced concrete prefabricated panels with gray corrugated steel panels on the outside.Lin Yue approached the nearest building and knocked on the wall with his hand - it was solid.Fifty centimeters thick, basically consistent with what Xiao He estimated on the satellite image last night.A concrete wall of this thickness cannot be broken by ordinary zombies, not to mention cracking it.Not even the licker's tongue can penetrate it.Unless it's a giant zombie.But the number of giant zombies is very small, and——

He wiped the dust on the wall with his finger.Good quality.It has not been maintained for five years, and there are no obvious cracks or signs of water damage.The quality of this building was better than any base he had stayed in in his previous life.

The northeast corner of the park is where the water well is located.Lin Yue walked over and found that it was a machine-made well. The wellhead was covered with a thick cast iron manhole cover. Next to it was a power distribution room and a rusted water tower.He opened the manhole cover and used his mobile phone's flashlight to shine down - the water surface was about eight meters deep and the quality of the water could not be clearly seen, but at least it was not dry.If you have water, you are alive.

The door lock of the power distribution room was rusty, so Lin Yue kicked it open.Inside is an old diesel generator set and distribution cabinet, covered with dust, but it doesn't look damaged.Wang Hao hasn't arrived yet, but Lin Yue has seen enough generator sets in his previous life. As long as this set of equipment can rotate, Fatty can make it come alive again.

He stood in the center of the park, turned around in a circle, and completed the first draft of the overall layout in his mind.

The cold storage building at the main entrance serves as the main defense, with the first floor being transformed into a command center and material warehouse, and an observation post being set up on the second floor.The two buildings at the back - one will be converted into a residential area, and the other will be converted into a medical area and laboratory.The open space next to the water tower is Zhao Dezhu's farmland.The open space along the east wall is Lu Hanshuang's training ground.There is a sentry tower in the southeast corner and northwest corner.Fifty meters outside the main entrance, there is the first line of barbed wire defense.Between barbed wire and walls, pits and trip wires.

He reviewed the entire park's defense system from beginning to end within five minutes, then took out his cell phone.

"On September 13, at 05:42, the cold chain logistics park was inspected and confirmed. Three cold storage buildings, with concrete prefabricated panel structures. The wall thickness is about 50 centimeters and the structure is intact. There is a well with a water depth of about eight meters. The power distribution room contains an old diesel generator set, and its status is pending.Assessment.The fence is a brick-concrete structure with a height of about 2.5 meters. There is no wire mesh at the top and it needs to be installed.The electric telescopic door of the main entrance cannot be used and needs to be manually closed.The area of the park is about 15,000 square meters and it can accommodate more than 100 people.The base location rating: S level.

He put away his phone and walked to the door.Zhao Ming's car should be arriving soon.

At six o'clock sharp, two black vans appeared at the entrance of the logistics park on time.The car door opened and five people filed out.The first thing Zhao Ming did when he got out of the car was not to say hello, but to glance at the surrounding environment - Lin Yue noticed that his eyes stopped on the wall of the first cold storage building for a second, and then nodded slightly.Lao Zheng was more direct. He walked around to the side to see the height of the fence and the terrain on the back, and left without saying a word.

"Is this right here?" Da Liu looked up at the cold storage building and raised his chin slightly, "It looks solid enough."

"A fifty centimeter concrete wall." Lin Yue said, "You can't break through it even if you hit it with a sledgehammer for a day."

Xiao He didn't say anything and had already started walking around the park, holding a small drone remote control in his hand.Ah Qing followed behind, carrying a first aid kit and looking around with an expression as if he was entering a haunted house for the first time.

"Brother Lin." Zhao Ming walked to Lin Yue and lowered his voice, "How do you get the property rights of this place? Although it is abandoned, there is an owner."

"I checked." Lin Yue said, "The property rights belong to a cold chain company that went bankrupt and liquidated. The asset package has been frozen for five years and no one has taken it. In theory, it is under the management of the North City Industrial Park Management Committee. But in fact, no one has taken care of it for five years, which shows that they don't care."

"Then we take it directly?"

"Follow the formal process." Lin Yue glanced at him, "Rent. Not buying, not occupying. Sign a formal contract. Once the contract is in hand, this place is legally our legal space. The law may be useless after the apocalypse, but before the apocalypse, I need this piece of paper. With it, we will not be regarded as suspicious when we buy barbed wire, cement, and generator accessories. With it, we will not be accused of illegal occupation when we bring people in. With it, the government will have to negotiate compensation with us even if it is temporarily expropriated."

Zhao Ming was stunned for a moment, then nodded slowly.He obviously didn't expect this level.In his previous life, Zhao Ming was a charging warrior, not a strategic commander.But in this life, Lin Yue needed him to grow faster.

"Today is Saturday." Lin Yue glanced at his watch. "The Industrial Park Management Committee is not working today. But on Monday morning, I will wait for them to open the door at the office door. Before that -"

Lao Zheng is back.His expression was darker than before.

"There is a small river on the back. The river bank is about fifteen meters wide. The depth of the water cannot be seen. The river flows in the southeast direction, and the lower reaches may lead to the main river in the city. This is a good thing and a bad thing."

"The good thing is that there is a backup water source," Lin Yue said, "What's the bad thing?"

"The bad thing is that the river bank is too low, and there is an abandoned building materials yard on the other side. The view is wide and there is no cover. If there are people or zombies coming from that direction, we can see them and they can see us. There is a gap in the wall at the back door, about one meter wide, which needs to be filled."

Lin Yue nodded and mentally prioritized the gap in the back wall.

"Xiao He," he raised his voice, "have you finished the aerial photography?"

Xiao He ran over from a short distance away, and the remote control screen in his hand showed a small four-axis drone hovering in mid-air.He turned the screen to Lin Yue, which showed an aerial view of the logistics park with high definition.

"The park is 320 meters long and 210 meters wide. There are three main buildings, a power distribution room, a water tower, and an abandoned loading and unloading platform. The fence runs along the entire plot, with a total length of about 1,060 meters. Within the surrounding 500 meters -—To the east is another abandoned industrial area with two empty factory buildings and no residents.To the west are a few car repair shops, and to the south is farmland with a row of bungalows that are still inhabited by farmers."

"Farmer?" Lin Yue frowned.

"A family. There are clothes hanging in the yard. They should have been dried yesterday."

Lin Yue recorded this information in his mind.The nearby residents are variables. When the apocalypse breaks out, they may become survivors or threats.But at least before it breaks out, no unnecessary attention can be drawn.

"The task this morning is to win the contract." Lin Yue gathered everyone together. "The management committee will not work on weekends, so we will find someone who can make the decision. There is no need to wait until Monday for this kind of thing. Xiao He, I want you to find out the contact information of a person this morning - the person in charge of asset management of the industrial park management committee, name, phone number, address, the sooner the better."

Xiao He nodded and started typing on his phone.

"Others, stay in the logistics park. Da Liu and Lao Zheng have figured out the internal structure of the three cold storage buildings. Each floor has several rooms, several doors, window sizes, stair positions, and ventilation duct directions. They have drawn them into sketches. I will take a look when I come back."

Da Liu and Lao Zheng nodded at the same time.

"Zhao Ming, take Ah Qing to check the water well. Bring a bucket of water up to see if the water is clean and can you drink it directly. Then check the power distribution room, take a photo of the generator model and send it to me."

"Understood." Zhao Ming said.

Lin Yue turned around and was about to leave, then stopped and looked back at the five of them.

"From now on, this logistics park will be our base of operations. Don't say any details about the base outside. No matter who asks, just say that we rented a warehouse and are going to do some small business. It exists."

The five people looked at him quietly.No one spoke, but everyone's eyes were different.Yesterday in the lounge, when they heard the word "the end of the world", they still had confusion, doubt, and forcibly suppressed disbelief in their eyes.But now - standing in this real cold chain logistics park, touching the thick concrete walls and seeing the bottomless machine shafts, those doubts are being worn away bit by bit.Because Lin Yue was not talking, he was doing.Every step is real.Every decision has clear reasons and direction.

Lin Yue got into the car and started the engine.The next stop is Su Muqing.

At 06:45, he arrived downstairs at Su Muqing's apartment.More than two hours earlier than the agreed nine o'clock.
